meta.name: paid-ads-review
meta.description: Produce a read-only, evidence-based paid-media performance review across connected platforms or supplied exports. Use for weekly or monthly reports, scorecards, performance, CPA, ROAS, CTR, spend trends, pacing, or conversion-tracking health.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总各平台广告数据，产出绩效报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每周要汇总多个广告平台数据做汇报
copy.tagline_en: Pull ad data from multiple platforms into a clear performance report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly compile advertising data from several platforms for reporting

howto.what: 生成只读的付费媒体绩效审查报告，包含各平台记分卡（花费、转化、CPA、ROAS、CTR、预算进度），对比上一周期，并给出主要贡献者、最大风险和一项建议动作。数据不足时标注缺失。
howto.when: 当你要求做周/月报、查看CPA/ROAS/CTR等指标、或核对花费趋势与预算进度时触发。

say.text: 帮我看一下上周的广告绩效周报
say.note: 生成各平台花费与转化对比。
标注数据缺失和追踪问题。
给出记分卡和风险提示。

howto.what_en: Generate a read-only paid media performance review: platform scorecard (spend, conversions, CPA, ROAS, CTR, pacing), period-over-period comparison, top contributor, biggest risk, and one recommended action. Flag missing data.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a weekly/monthly report, mention metrics like CPA/ROAS/CTR, or request spend trends or budget pacing.

say_en.text: Check if this month's CPA and ROAS meet targets.
say_en.note: Flags missing data and tracking issues.

say_en.text: Compare Google and Meta spend and conversions.
